name: product_three
title: 产品三灯
what: Three lamps for a glossy object framed close (the film's arc): the key a large softbox above and behind, whose reflection lies over the visible top of the object as a soft gradient; a low strip behind, whose reflection runs along the arc; a soft fill from the front left for the body's colour; a wash on the ground behind.

look_target.note: a reference film: a look target for the light only, never material truth

shots.what: cloisonne on purple: soft key from the upper left, bright rim on the far edge, background brighter behind
jade on pink: soft key, specular sheen along the edge, graded background
enamel and shell on yellow: soft key, many small highlights, even background

spectrum.why: v0: every lamp of a rig has the same spectrum, the key light rgbscene projects with, so one bounce is exact (docs/optics.md); 5500 K blackbody: a stand-in for daylight-balanced studio flash or LED, our choice

lamps.name: key
lamps.why: our choice: a large softbox close (6 R x 4 R at 3 R), above and behind. S3 review: the highlights were small and hard, the look targets have large soft light with gradients; framed as the film (the camera 20 degrees down, the top of the object filling the frame) a glossy surface mirrors only what is above and behind it (20 to 70 degrees up), so the soft source has to be there

lamps.name: rim
lamps.why: our choice: a long low strip behind; near the arc the surface turns to grazing and mirrors it, a bright line along the edge

lamps.name: fill
lamps.why: our choice: the first version's key, made large and close (S3 review); from the front it lights the body, not the gloss

lamps.name: bg
lamps.why: washes the ground the camera sees behind the arc, from behind right, out of frame (from straight behind and above, the key's black body shadowed it: S3, 0.1% of the light)

backdrop.why: the default ground; a recipe sets the colour for its object (backdrop.material)
